jing: quick heads-up — automated subtitle eval on nova-lite-q4 shows consistent SRT cue drift for JA/ZH mixed transcripts. full run attached below.
kevin: ugh, SRT drift? like timestamps move or text moves between cues?
jing: timestamps shift — cues end up ~400–700ms earlier than gold. causes overlap on short-dialogue lines. reproducer:
```
python tools/eval_subtitles.py --model nova-lite-q4 --quant int4 --input tests/fixtures/multi_ja_zh_srt/episode042.srt --out outputs/nova_q4_ep42.srt
```
jing: diff snippet (gold vs nova-lite-q4):
Gold:
00:01:22,300 --> 00:01:22,900
「行くよ」

Nova-q4:
00:01:21,900 --> 00:01:22,500
「行くよ」

jing: token counts differ (gold 9, nova-q4 7) — seems numeric/time punctuation merged/split and affecting pacing.
olivia: detok issues (ZWJ/ZWSP) or model emitting fewer tokens? paste tokenized sequence?
jing: examples (codepoints shown):
Gold tokens: ["00:01:22", ",300", "-->", "00:01:22", ",900", "\n", "\u300c", "\u884c\u304f", "\u3088", "\u300d"]
Nova tokens: ["00:01:21,900-->", "00:01:22,500", "\n", "\u300c\u884c\u304f\u3088\u300d"]

jing: nova merged timecode+arrow into one token; serializer computes cue times from token indexes -> drift.
takashi: only int4 or float16 too?
jing: float16 ok. int4-specific merge likely from quantized decoding remap or pruned BPE merges.
kevin: bisect idea: run decode with --log-tokens on both quant settings.
jing: log shows int4 output token_id=34567 token_str=\"00:01:21,900-->\" at step 12, then token_id=19 token_str=\"00:01:22,500\".
eval-bot: automated alert: subtitle_timing_regression detected (delta_mean=-0.52s) on branch bringup/nova-lite-q4 for locales [ja, zh-Hans]. No RTL flagged.
takashi: run repro with --force-tokenizer=host-bpe to rule out runtime remap.
jing: running now, ETA ~15m. if runtime remap, patch to avoid merged token emissions for patterns with :, , --> until root-cause.
olivia: add mitigation: serializer should prefer regex-extracted timestamps \d{2}:\d{2}:\d{2},\d{3} from raw text as fallback.
jing: PR incoming to parser to prefer explicit timestamp regex and ignore token-derived offsets for now.
kevin: thanks. if int4 flaky we may hold nova-lite-q4 rollout for streaming captioning customers. :thumbsup:
